subject: Equinox Consulting — integration & governance technical validation
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@equinox-consulting.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira.khan@equinox-consulting.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Partnership: technical validation kickoff and governance pack

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Equinox is excited to move from PoC to a validated reference integration for our managed services offering. Our engineering and procurement teams want to run a short technical validation focused on: network topology and VPC peering, data residency controls, KMS/HSM key flow, and a run-through of your Dedicated & Private deployment options.

Attached is a starting reference architecture (equinox-reference-arch-v1.pdf) and a basic network diagram (network-diagram.png). Can your team confirm the validation scope, provide a short test plan we can run (preferably the week of Dec 13), and list any compliance artifacts you need?

High-level asks from our side:
- Outline of reference API endpoints and expected IP ranges
- List of required roles/creds for sandbox access (timeboxed)
- Example data retention and audit-log export cadence

I'll loop in procurement if we need a statement of work. Proposed point people: Alex Mercer (me) and Samira Khan (integration lead).

Best,
Alex

Attachments: equinox-reference-arch-v1.pdf (diagram), network-diagram.png
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@equinox-consulting.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Partnership: technical validation kickoff and governance pack

Alex — thanks for the clear doc set and diagram. We're aligned on scope and can run a focused validation next week. Below is a pragmatic plan from Redwood's side; I'll be the technical lead and Marissa will coordinate procurement/rates.

Proposed validation plan (high level):
1) Sandbox spin-up (1 day): ephemeral Dedicated sandbox in us-west-2 with sample model and logging; we provide timeboxed API keys.
2) Connectivity & networking (1/2 day): verify IP ranges, VPC peering, and firewall rules from your diagram.
3) KMS/key flow & encryption at rest (1/2 day): walkthrough of KMS integration (we support customer-managed keys for Private).
4) Audit & retention test (1/2 day): export logs, validate retention windows and S3 lifecycle configs.
5) Optional load/latency smoke (1 day): short token-generation bursts to measure latency/throughput on Dedicated node.

Deliverables:
- Short runbook with commands + expected outputs (I'll attach redwood-integrations-checklist.pdf)
- Snapshot of audit logs and retention worksheet
- Access token with expiry and instructions

Pre-reqs from Equinox:
- Sandbox maintainer email and a single IP for an initial test range
- Test dataset (sanitized) or sample prompts you want validated
- Confirmation on whether you prefer customer-managed keys (Private) or Redwood-managed (Dedicated)

Can you confirm availability Dec 14–16 for the hands-on sessions? We'll keep sessions short (2–3 hours total each day) and timezone-friendly PST.

Karthik

Attachment: redwood-integrations-checklist.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@equinox-consulting.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-06T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Partnership: technical validation kickoff and governance pack

Alex — adding a couple of notes from an architecture/ops perspective:

- For the sandbox we propose using a Dedicated pool with restricted IAM and a timebound policy; this minimizes blast radius while giving realistic performance numbers.
- If Equinox plans to go Private (VPC/on-prem) later, we'll want to capture network CIDR overlap early. Please confirm whether your internal ranges include 10.0.0.0/8 or are smaller subnets.
- On KMS: our Private offering supports linking to your KMS via a cross-account role; for the validation we'll simulate the flow unless you want to bring actual keys (which we can do for a later step).
- Compliance artifacts: we can share SOC2 summary, data flow diagrams, and audit-log samples after an NDA or a signed mutual NDA addendum.

Quick logistics: Karthik — we'll provision the sandbox on Dec 14 morning PST and send credentials with a 72-hr expiry. Alex — please provide a maintainer email and a jump-host IP by EOD Dec 9.

Laura
